text.en:
Item (f), Section two (f), (43 Quezon), page 109; projects B-421.43, page 680, B-421.52, page 678, B-421.62, page 682, and B-421.64, page 684, Appendix A; and priority numbered twenty-four, page 79, Appendix B, of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(f) Maria Aurora Municipal Building, Construction and/or repair ₱3,000.00 "B-421.43. Jumalig Barrio Road, Polillo, Construction 2,000.00 "B-421.52. Poblacion-Callejon Road, San Antonio Construction 2,000.00 "B-421.62. Poblacion-Callejon Feeder Road, San Antonio Construction 4,000.00 "B-421.64. Ilog-agos River Barrio Road, Infanta, Completion 4,000.00 "Priority 24. Panukalan Home Economics Building, Polillo, Construction 5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
